summary: CalciMedica filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $25,000,000 of common stock through sales agent H.C. Wainwright, tied to its March 2026 shelf registration. Shares trade on Nasdaq under CALC, last reported at $1.695 on September 28, 2026. Wainwright receives a 3.0% fixed commission and acts on a commercially reasonable efforts basis with no escrow. This is a routine equity shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and any acceleration in share sales given the depressed price.
